attributes.name: hand_at_mouth
attributes.text: A hand comes to the front of the mouth and stays there.
attributes.definition: The hand joint ends at or directly in front of the mouth, at the center of the face, for at least a short pause. Hands placed at the ear, forehead or top of head do not count.

attributes.name: hand_at_ear
attributes.text: A hand rests at the side of the head next to the ear.
attributes.definition: One or both hands are positioned at the side of the head at ear level, not in front of the face and not on top of the head.

attributes.name: hand_on_top_of_head
attributes.text: A hand touches the top of the head.
attributes.definition: The hand reaches the crown of the head, above the ears, at some point in the action.

attributes.name: hand_on_forehead
attributes.text: A hand touches the forehead or temple.
attributes.definition: The hand stops at the upper front or upper side of the face, above the eyes, rather than at the mouth or ear.

attributes.name: hands_on_face_both
attributes.text: Both hands touch the face at the same time.
attributes.definition: Both hand joints are at the face (eyes, nose, cheeks) together for a moment.

attributes.name: hands_touch_each_other
attributes.text: The two hands touch each other in front of the body.
attributes.definition: The right and left hand joints meet or overlap in front of the torso at some point, not counting crossed forearms where the hands are apart.

attributes.name: hand_on_opposite_arm
attributes.text: A hand rests on the other forearm or upper arm.
attributes.definition: One hand ends on the other arm (wrist, forearm or near the elbow) rather than on the other hand.

attributes.name: hand_on_chest_or_belly
attributes.text: A hand is pressed against the front of the torso.
attributes.definition: One or both hands rest on the chest or stomach area of the same person, touching the torso.

attributes.name: hand_behind_back
attributes.text: A hand reaches behind the torso to the back.
attributes.definition: A hand joint moves to a position behind the plane of the torso, at the lower or upper back.

attributes.name: hand_behind_neck
attributes.text: A hand reaches the back of the neck or back of the head.
attributes.definition: The hand passes behind the head and stops at the back of the neck or lower back of the head.

attributes.name: hand_at_own_hip
attributes.text: A hand moves to the side of the hip or upper thigh.
attributes.definition: One hand ends at or beside the same person's hip or upper thigh, not in front of the body.

attributes.name: hand_near_foot
attributes.text: A hand comes down near the foot or the floor.
attributes.definition: A hand joint lowers until it is at the height of the ankles or feet.

attributes.name: forearms_cross
attributes.text: The two forearms cross over each other in front of the body.
attributes.definition: The left and right forearms overlap in front of the chest or face so each hand is on the opposite side of the body.
